title: A Rank for Discontinuities of Multivalued Functions
summary: We study discontinuity of multivalued functions (also known as problems) $P$ on Baire space by assigning an ordinal rank to points in the domain of $P$ that have no local realizers. For each countable ordinal $α$, let $\mathsf{ACC}_{\mathbb N}^α$ be the problem of solving $\mathsf{ACC}_{\mathbb N}$ in at most $α$ many attempts, with a new instance provided for each attempt.
